## Server

LeafLink and SideQuests both took 2nd place at their hackathons, and I run my own LLM inference server at home.

Rendering of the inference server: 6,144 lanes, one per CUDA core on the RTX 3070 Ti, firing 32 at a time.

## LeafLink

Mutual aid on a live map. When a neighbor needs what you have, the map connects you as it happens.

Week-long hackathon build. Team of four: Justin Poli, Julian Shuster, Devin Perez, Colton A. 2nd place.

WebSocket live feed, Leaflet maps, tag and category search.

Code: https://codeberg.org/bon3head/LeafLink

## SideQuests

A community platform anyone can host, built as quests on ActivityPub. Each community runs its own instance and sets its own quests.

Hackathon build with Julian Shuster. 2nd place.

Built at Hack New Paltz. Working MVP in 24 hours.

Code: https://codeberg.org/bon3head/sidequests
